text.jp:
いつかセイレーンさまの前で歌うのが、
わたしの夢なの！
text.official_en: It’s my dream to sing in front of her someday... Hope she listens...
text.real_en: It's my dream to sing in front of Siren-sama someday!

text.jp:
いろんな国の奴が買いに来るが、
うちの武器が一番って言ってくれるぜ。
text.official_en: Folks from all over stop by my shop, and they all say I have the best weapons anywhere!

text.jp:
うちのとーちゃん、ふねがだせないからって
ずーっと、いえにいるんだ。
text.official_en: My pa’s lounging around the house all day since his ship’s not going anywhere.
text.real_en: My dad's been at home all the time because he can't take his ship out.

text.jp:
え？　どんな場所だって？
たしか……ちょっと高台になった
場所だったと思う。
text.official_en: Hm? What sort of place was it? I don’t remember precisely, but as I recall it was on higher ground...

text.jp:
かなり危険な魔物に襲われて、
あのときは生きた心地がしなかったよ。
text.official_en: They were nasty critters, too. The color drained from my face just looking at them.
text.real_en: A really dangerous monster attacked me. I thought I was going to die.

text.jp:
かなり危険な魔物のため、討伐隊を組みたいのですが、
まだ騎士団の手が回らず……
こうして注意喚起をしております。
text.official_en: We’ve put in a request to form a hunting party, but with everything going on, the Order’s yet to address the issue...leaving us to merely warn travelers of it.
text.real_en: That ogre is extremely dangerous, so we'd like to put together a hunting party, but the knights are stretched too thin... For now, all we can do is warn people.

text.jp: きょうは、なにしてあそんでもらおうかな？
text.official_en: Guess I’ll ask him to play with me today...again.
text.real_en: I wonder what I'll ask him to play with me today!

text.jp: くぅ！　惑わされたいぜ！
text.official_en: Hoo-wee! What I wouldn’t give to be allured by her.

text.jp:
ここは、港町グランポート。
人と物資が行き交う町……。
text.official_en: Welcome to Grandport, where the people and goods flow to and fro...

text.jp:
ここより北東。
砂漠にある洞窟にオーガが棲みついているそうです。
text.official_en: There’s an ogre that’s settled in the desert cave to the northeast.

text.jp:
このまま船が出ないと、
ディルナドで売るはずだった魚が
ダメになってしまうな……。
text.official_en: Looks like the ships will be moored for a while. At this rate, the fish I was gonna sell in Dirnado’s all gonna go bad...
text.real_en: If the ships don't set sail soon, the fish I was supposed to sell in Dirnado will go bad...

text.jp:
この町の東の方に
古びた宮殿があるでしょ？
text.official_en: You know that ancient palace to the east of town?

text.jp: こんなに海が荒れてちゃ、船は出せないな……。
text.official_en: Och, no way we can sail with the seas this choppy...

text.jp:
そこには、姫を名乗る
変わった人が住んでいるらしいのよね。
text.official_en: Well, I hear a strange woman lives there who insists she’s a princess.

text.jp:
だけど……グランシェルトに
お姫様なんていないわよね？
text.official_en: Except...Grandshelt doesn’t have a princess, right?

text.jp:
だけど、あんな場所で修行したら
きっと早く強くなれるんじゃないかな。
ま、俺にはそんな勇気はないけどね。
text.official_en: I bet you’d get strong really fast if you trained there...not that I have the courage to do so myself.

text.jp:
でも、いいわ。
彼は船……私は港。
いつか帰ってきてくれるって信じているから。
text.official_en: I’ve made peace with it, though. I am the port, and he is the ship. He’ll sail back to me one day.

text.jp:
とおちゃんが、ふねにのせてくれるんだって！
ふねのうえで、なにしてあそんでもらおうかな？
text.official_en: Pa’s gonna let me on his ship! I’m gonna ask him to play with me when we’re on it!

text.jp:
よっしゃ！
ディルナドに脂の乗った新鮮な魚を届けるぜ！
text.official_en: All righty! Hope those folks in Dirnado are ready for some fresh fish!
text.real_en: All right! I'll deliver some fresh, fatty fish to Dirnado!

text.jp:
わたしね、セイレーンさまのお歌が大好きなんだ！
だけど……最近歌ってくれないの。
お風邪をひいちゃったのかな……？
text.official_en: I love Lady Siren’s singing! But...she hasn’t sung for us in a while... I wonder if she caught a cold?
text.real_en: I love Siren-sama's singing! But... she hasn't sung lately. I wonder if she caught a cold...

text.jp:
グランシェルトの騎士様を乗せたんだぞって、
妻と子供に自慢しちまったよ。
text.official_en: Havin’ t’ ferry you knights of Grandshelt made fer a nice story to tell me wife and kids.
text.real_en: I even bragged to my wife and kids that I'd had knights of Grandshelt aboard!

text.jp:
セイレーンさま、また歌ってくれたの！
やっぱり、ステキ……！
text.official_en: Did you hear it!? Lady Siren sang! It was beautiful!
text.real_en: Siren-sama sang again! It was wonderful, just like always...!

text.jp:
セイレーンの歌で今日も海は絶好調さ。
この波なら、船旅も快適だな。
で、どこにいきたいんだ？
text.official_en: Siren’s song has given us another day of clear sailin’. So, where d’ya wanna go?
text.real_en: With Siren's song, the sea is in perfect shape again today. With waves like these, it'll be a comfortable voyage. So, where to?

text.jp: ビジョンを強化するクポ？
text.official_en: Wanna enhance your visions, kupo?

text.jp:
中には何があったんだろうなぁ。
金銀財宝か？　それとも伝説の武器か？
やっぱり、幻獣か？
text.official_en: I wonder what was inside. Riches of silver and gold? A legendary weapon? Or perhaps it was an esper!
text.real_en: I wonder what was inside. Gold and silver treasure? A legendary weapon? Or maybe an Eidolon?

text.jp:
北東の砂漠にいった時なんだけどさ、
他とは違う魔物が出る場所が
あったんだよな……。
text.official_en: When I ventured into the northeastern reaches of the desert, I found a place with monsters I’d never seen before.

text.jp:
子供のために
何か遊べるものとかないかしら。
text.official_en: I wonder if there’s anything that my children can play with...

text.jp:
彼女、頼み事を聞くと
ご褒美にお宝をくれるみたいよ。
なんだか、本物のお姫様みたいよね……。
text.official_en: Still, she’ll apparently reward you with treasure if you do what she asks. Almost like an actual princess!

text.jp: 海が落ち着くまでは船は出せないよ。
text.official_en: I’m sorry, sires, but we can’t sail yet. Ya have t’ wait till the seas calm a tad.
text.real_en: We can't sail until the sea calms down.

text.jp:
潮風に揺られて届く様々な国の名産品。
ここなら欲しいものも必ず見つかるぞい。
text.official_en: Goods from around the world make their way here. I’m sure you’ll find what you’re looking for.

text.jp:
知ってるか？
絶世の美女と噂のセイレーンさまには、
人を惑わす力もあるらしい。
text.official_en: Did you know? Lady Siren is rumored to be not only jaw-droppingly beautiful, but has the power to allure people.
text.real_en: Did you know? Siren-sama is said to be breathtakingly beautiful, but she apparently also has the power to charm people.

text.jp:
砂漠にあった大きな石が
なくなったらしいんだ！
text.official_en: Rumor has it that the large boulder in the desert is gone now!

text.jp:
自分の体を守るものだ。
用心しすぎなぐらいがちょうどいいぞ。
text.official_en: A good, solid piece of armor is what stands between you and injury—or worse. When you think of it that way, there’s no such thing as being too prepared.

text.jp:
船……出航できるようになったのね……
つまりあの人も……。
text.official_en: So the ships are sailing again... Which means my love will sail away, too...
text.real_en: The ships... They can set sail again... Which means that man will, too...

text.jp:
荷物の運搬には、ぜひとも
うちのチョコボ車のご利用を！
text.official_en: If you need anything transported, look no further than our chocobo carriages!

text.jp:
貴方たちの実力を侮っているわけではありませんが、
どうかお気をつけください。
text.official_en: While I do not doubt your prowess, do be careful.

text.jp:
貴方と私の出会いも、
ただ過ぎていく流れのひとつにすぎないのかしら？
うふふ。
text.official_en:
I wonder...is our encounter to be just as fleeting, though?
Hehe...
